discovered_issues.summary: Replacing the cross-run Chinese suffix '拓扑方案' with '拓扑验证' produced NUL bytes in the preceding run when tested against this WPS sample on clean HEAD.
discovered_issues.root_cause: replace.go locateBlockSpan selected the first run using gei > lo without requiring the match to overlap that run; later-run matches could be anchored to an earlier run.
discovered_issues.fix: locateBlockSpan now requires gsi < hi && gei > lo when selecting the first overlapped run.
discovered_issues.evidence: /tmp/opencode/ext-0024.diff.json and /tmp/opencode/ext-0024.edited.pptx reproduced the bug; /tmp/opencode/ext-0024.zhfix.edited.pptx verified the fix with no NUL bytes.
